instruction: Buy the highest rated gaming console available on Amazon now, one for each of my following friends, Kyle , Kayla. They have to be gift wrapped and delivered to their respective home addresses. If the total delivery fee is higher than the monthly prime subscription cost, subscribe me to prime first.
notes: Friends' home addresses come from phone.search_contacts (home_address string parsed into street/city/state/country/zip; recipient name = contact's full name) and are added as new Amazon addresses (adding is allowed; updating/deleting existing addresses is not). The highest-rated in-stock gaming console is found via amazon.search_products(product_type='gaming console', sort_by='-rating') and confirmed with amazon.show_product, which also yields its delivery_fee. The prime decision is a runtime comparison: total delivery fee (2 orders x product delivery_fee, read from show_product) vs. monthly prime price (15, from show_prime_plans). Classical PDDL cannot branch, so the problem encodes the branch with the static fact (prime-beneficial); the reference plan assumes it holds and subscribes monthly before ordering. If at runtime the delivery total is not higher than 15, drop (prime-beneficial) and put (prime-handled) in :init instead; the planner then skips amazon.subscribe_prime and the goal is otherwise unchanged. Two separate orders are required (one per address): add product (qty 1) to cart, gift-wrap it, place_order with that friend's address_id; cart/gift-wrap flags are reset by place_order so the sequence repeats for the second friend. supervisor.complete_task takes the two order records (not API arguments) so its precondition equals the goal, and it is forced last via (task-completed).

plan: (amazon-add-address kayla-name kayla-street kayla-city kayla-state kayla-country kayla-zip amazon-token address-kayla kayla)
(amazon-add-address kyle-name kyle-street kyle-city kyle-state kyle-country kyle-zip amazon-token address-kyle kyle)
(amazon-place-order amazon-card address-kayla amazon-token order-kayla kayla top-gaming-console)
(amazon-place-order amazon-card address-kyle amazon-token order-kyle kyle top-gaming-console)
